title: French Students Walk Out Again. In 1968 It Nearly Toppled de Gaulle #shorts
description:
This week, 'Black Thursday' protests that began with French high school students spread across the country. In May 1968 it started the same way: students, then barricades, then ten million workers on strike, and a president who vanished to West Germany.
